title: textBoundary
summary: Create a pattern matching the start or end of text.

gpu_support.notes: No GPU kernel is registered for this compatibility builtin; it creates host pattern metadata.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes a host pattern object.

description: `textBoundary` creates a lightweight RunMat `pattern` object that matches the start or end of text.
behaviors: `textBoundary` and `textBoundary("either")` create a pattern that matches either the start or end of a text scalar.
`textBoundary("start")` matches only the start of text.
`textBoundary("end")` matches only the end of text.
The boundary `type` argument accepts string scalars or character vectors and is matched case-insensitively.
Returned pattern objects are regular-expression-backed and can be used by RunMat pattern-aware string APIs such as `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `erase`, and `replace`.
Full MATLAB pattern-expression algebra, including `textBoundary + otherPattern` composition and `~textBoundary` negation, remains broader pattern infrastructure work.

examples.output: `pat` is a pattern object backed by a start-of-text boundary.
`pat` is a pattern object backed by an end-of-text boundary.

faqs.question: Does `textBoundary` support pattern negation?
faqs.answer: Not in this slice. The constructor returns a boundary pattern object, but full MATLAB pattern algebra such as `~textBoundary` remains broader pattern infrastructure work.

faqs.question: Does `textBoundary` execute on the GPU?
faqs.answer: No. It creates host pattern metadata; pattern-aware text consumers gather GPU-resident text before matching.

gpu_residency: `textBoundary` creates a host pattern object; no provider-resident execution is applicable.
